owner: CC builds it; cairn/devices/tester owns the exception arm, the counts bucket and the summary line
intent_berth: none, because a defect does not route through /intent; the origin record is commit b62670d in ~/dev/src/cairn and the 2026-09-10 measurement of test_hollow.py recorded in `measured_at_cast` above

watchme.trigger: on the beat, at the at-rest probe sweep over class-space. It censuses every validation across both roots and fires when any standing record carries verdict 'red' whose evidence.stderr_tail begins 'timed out after' - the exact shape today's write leaves, so the probe can be made to fire on demand by handing it the pre-build writer.
watchme.enough: 30 consecutive days with that census at zero AND at least one timeout actually reported by a run in the window. Stillness alone is not enough, and the reason is measured rather than theoretical: cairn/tools/base/probes/a_pickup_is_witnessed.py clears on a historical existence claim and has read green off one August 2026 fact ever since. A corpus where nothing ever times out would clear this probe while saying nothing about the write.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier, carrying the count of standing validations at verdict red with a timed-out stderr_tail, the count of timeouts reported by runs in the window, and the budget each was charged against
watchme.consumer: the tester's diagnostic surface and the operator inbox, where a manufactured red is a record-of-truth defect to fix rather than a note to read

workflow_and_state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> [BUILDME:waiting] -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(timeout_is_not_a_red) -> PROVED
